Simple & Elegant
Nov 2018 • Family
My family spent 5 days in Ho Chi Minh city, we stayed at Somerset Chancellor Court Serviced Residence and someone there recommended Thu Pho VIetnamese Cuisine. We went there across the street. The overall experience was really good. The food was delicious, the staff was friendly and made us feel really comfortable. We don't know much about Vietnamese food but the staff was really helpful in suggesting orders. The price is average, we had group of 3 and the bill was just about only $30. Specially they have the receipt in English! I definitely recommend this place.

Best Restaurant in Ho Chi Min City
Nov 2018 • Couples
We had been traveling around Vietnam for over two weeks eating great food and then we stumbled onto Thu Pho Vietnamese Resturant in District 1 and the food and service blew our minds.
This restaurant just opened but you wouldn't know it because the food is fantastic and comes out hot off the stove. Don't miss the prawns, mixed veggies and the braised tofu. Really yummy. They also have Hot Pot and Great Pho. The people sitting at the next table came to this restaurant every day they were in Saigon.....You gota try it!!!!!
